title: What makes a Mall world dream a Mall world dream?
content: Hey guys. I've been thinking about something. What makes a Mall world dream a Mall world dream? I believe there is something beyond the Mall itself. I mean, I can dream about a mall and it still not be a mall world dream. I feel like there is a specific feeling in the mall world dreams. There is a slight nostalgic feeling, there is a constant oddness too. How do you differentiate these dreams from others? What is special or different about these dreams?
